# QR codes

## Endpoint

`GET /api/v1/urls/{code}/qr` returns a QR code that encodes the short URL (`<base-url>/<code>`).

| Parameter | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | `png` | `png` or `svg` (case-insensitive) |
| `size` | `256` | Edge length in pixels, 64 to 1024 |

## Errors

- `400` for a size outside the range or an unknown format
- `404` for an unknown code, `410` for a deleted or expired one (same as the redirect)

# Changelog

## QR code endpoint

- Added `GET /api/v1/urls/{code}/qr` (PNG and SVG), generated in-process with ZXing core.
